desc: decision 49 in round I1a's automatic join (fix-d43): World:ArrivalPrompt off, so an arrival takes the automatic join of the row the prompt would preselect (with the prompt on, the path of a fresh arrival from a field, which since fix-d43's review no known flow reaches); a hosts a Public instance in stag0101 and plays there; b, a stranger who remembers Private, takes the gate when a's instance runs (not starting) with a at the arrival stage: b's BARRIER refuses a's instance (auto_join_refused by=remembered) and makes b's own Private instance; before fix-d43 b joined a's instance as a guest

db_checks.name: a's instance Public with a alone
db_checks.sql: SELECT h.visibility, COUNT(*) FROM instance_history h JOIN instance_history_members m ON m.instance_id = h.id WHERE h.host_account_id = {id:a} GROUP BY h.id

db_checks.name: b's instance Private with b alone
db_checks.sql: SELECT h.visibility, COUNT(*) FROM instance_history h JOIN instance_history_members m ON m.instance_id = h.id WHERE h.host_account_id = {id:b} GROUP BY h.id

db_checks.name: b was nobody's guest
db_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instance_history_members WHERE account_id = {id:b} AND role <> 'host'
